scope: CPU-only source research; no candidate execution, node access, GPU work or serving change

sources.title: DiscoveryRSI: Recursively Learning to Discover Valuable Hypotheses
sources.quote: Scientific value can arise from a new explanation
sources.lesson: Separate hypothesis progress, execution readiness and measured support; version scientific ancestry independently from shared evidence.
sources.limitation: Recent method study; scores and post-cutoff correspondence are not our deployment performance.

sources.title: Scideator: Human-LLM Compound System for Scientific Ideation through Facet Recombination and Novelty Evaluation
sources.lesson: Retrieve and combine selected mechanism facets with the target purpose; do not transfer entire paper constraints.
sources.limitation: 22-person ideation study, not demonstrated inference wins; evaluation facets were not clearly useful to participants.

sources.title: The Agentic Scientist: Orchestrating Coding Agents for Automated Scientific (Co-)Discovery
sources.quote: rubrics check only the criteria they enumerate
sources.lesson: Typed intent/evidence handoffs and external checks; rubric completion must remain separate from performance selection.
sources.limitation: Paper reports unflagged evaluation-protocol violations; no universal rubric can certify science.

sources.title: Towards an AI co-scientist
sources.quote: An identified error doesn’t necessarily invalidate the core hypothesis
sources.lesson: Decompose assumptions; repair peripheral failures and independently search for supporting and opposing evidence.
sources.limitation: Mostly biomedical validation and open-literature coverage; negative results may be missing.

sources.title: SciMON: Scientific Inspiration Machines Optimized for Novelty
sources.quote: retrieval of “inspirations” from past scientific papers
sources.lesson: Use problem/setting/goal context to retrieve inspirations and revise an idea; keep novelty optional.
sources.limitation: Abstract-level reading in this pass; novelty objective differs from useful deployment improvement.

sources.title: Large Language Models Cannot Self-Correct Reasoning Yet
sources.lesson: Require critique to name an inspected contradiction, calculation or discriminating test, not merely another model opinion.
sources.limitation: GPT-3.5/GPT-4/Llama-2 reasoning experiments; not a theorem about all later systems or tasks.
